title.narrative: OAK states: Number of States completing community mapping of access to basic education for children with special needs

comment.narrative: This indicator tracks the number of States completing community mapping of access to basic education of children with special needs includes: (a) mapping of available screening and counselling services for dealing with disabilities; (b) mapping of teacher training programs in inclusive education; and (c) mapping schools capacity (physical and human resources) to increase the enrolment of children with special needs. The mapping exercise is already ongoing in Oyo, while Adamawa and Katsina need to expedite and complete their implementation by December 2025.

title.narrative: OAK states: Number of States conducting digital data collection on students, teachers and schools

comment.narrative: The Program helped develop a digital app for collecting the Annual School Census (ASC) data. Both Katsina and Oyo have deployed the app for ASC data collection. Adamawa plans to deploy the app by October 2025 to use it for the 2026 ASC.

title.narrative: OAK states: Number of SBMCs in underserved communities receive infrastructure improvement grants

comment.narrative: The IVA' review confirmed that, of the 270 primary schools that were selected for the first round of school infrastructure upgrades (Oyo – 105; Adamawa – 15 and Katsina – 150), signed Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs), and received grants from their state governments to provide additional classrooms and WASH facilities, a total of 212 primary schools (Oyo – 91; Adamawa – 15 and Katsina – 106) met the conditions of having construction work that complied with the UBEC minimum standards and are eligible for reward. The remaining 58 primary schools (Oyo – 14; Katsina - 44) require reverification, which is planned for February 2026.

title.narrative: OAK states: Number of SBMCs in underserved communities receive infrastructure improvement grants

title.narrative: OAK states: Number of states that approve SPP training package

comment.narrative: This new indicator introduced as part of the June 2025 restructuring and adopted from the HOPE-EDU Program will track the progress among OAK states in approving the training modules for teachers and mentors who will deliver the SPP for literacy and numeracy, as well as budgeted training logistics and mentoring plans for each Local Government Education Authority (LGEA) covering all primary and JSS teachers and mentors. The result is expected to be reported by December 2025.

title.narrative: OAK states: NFLCs have Management Committee, teacher, and TLMs

comment.narrative: This new indicator, introduced as part of the June 2025 restructuring and adopted from the HOPE-EDU Program, tracks the number of non-formal learning centers (NFLCs) that have: (i) an established center-based management committee (CBMC), of which at least the chairperson has been trained on NFLC functions; (ii) a paid facilitator/instructor who is qualified to teach non-formal basic education (NFBE) programs; and (iii) received approved NFBE teaching learning materials (TLMs). An intermediate result is expected to be reported by January 2026, after the following steps have been completed: creation of a database and mapping of existing NFLCs and instructors in OAK states; training of CBMCs on NFLC functions; identification of facilitators/instructors qualified to teach NFBE programs; and procurement of approved NFBE TLMs.

title.narrative: OAK states: Number of states that have published reports on teacher competency or student learning outcomes

comment.narrative: This new indicator, introduced as part of the June 2025 restructuring, will track the number of states that publish reports on either student learning outcomes based on national learning assessment results or teachers progress in acquiring applied knowledge and competency in facilitating structured pedagogy. For the latter, an app will be used to track and assess teacher performance and growth in different aspects of professional capabilities and knowledge gained through the SPP. An intermediate result is expected to be reported by January 2026.
